proposed_english: throughout; during; all through; long/very long (طُوال, depending on vocalization/use)

note: متى is an interrogative noun/adverb of time (اسم استفهام/ظرف زمان), not an interrogative particle.

The unvocalized form ضبط covers the verbal noun 'control/adjustment' and the perfect verb 'controlled/adjusted'; learner metadata should identify the actual finite verb reading rather than generic 'to control'.
وطنية also functions as the abstract noun 'patriotism/national feeling', not only as a feminine adjective.
خلف is also the very common noun/adverbial form خَلْف meaning 'behind; back; rear', omitted by the current verb-only entry.
proposed_english: behind; back; rear; succeeded/followed; came after (depending on vocalization/use)

note: أَلَمْ is compositionally the interrogative hamza أَ + negative particle لم, while أَلَم is the noun 'pain'; calling the former simply a particle hides the construction.
proposed_pos: noun / interrogative particle + negative particle sequence

note: منظمة can mean 'organization' (مُنَظَّمة) and 'organized' in the feminine passive-participle/adjectival reading; the latter common reading is omitted.
